title: Scrubbing or pausing Live during a Spotify track start keeps music playing
acceptance: A seek, skip, or pause then resume during an in-flight Spotify start ends playing or buffering at the new position (the Spotify half of lane repro CM-01 passes).

The Spotify adapter implements the whenIdle() settle signal (the runtime side is already on main: runtime.ts calls adapter.whenIdle()), so runtime.enterTrack waits for a cancelled Spotify start, bounded to about 3 s, and re-checks the epoch before prepare; a never-settling call ends in a bounded, clearly worded error.
Owner device check: audible scrub, pause and resume on desktop Chrome with Spotify.
nextAction: RF-158 is deployed (main 579c5950, Worker 78f9eb69, 2026-11-13). Owner device check (criterion 3): desktop Chrome with Spotify Premium, start a Spotify class, then within the first second or two of a track (while it is still starting) (a) scrub to a later point, (b) skip to the next track, (c) pause then resume. Each should end playing at the new position with no "still finishing" error. Criteria 1 and 2 are proved with mock players only. Record the result here.

evidence.summary: Final review of #667, item 1: RF-108 acceptance needed Spotify (CM-01 Spotify half, desktop Chrome) while every Spotify Web API call returns 403 until RF-92.

RF-108 PR that split this record out. Its whenIdle() adapter contract and bounded runtime settle wait were reverted out of #668 on 2026-10-30 (owner: measure first) and are preserved on wip/rf-108-apple-locks; RF-108's redesign defines the settle signal this record implements for Spotify.
On main f9aba1b7 runtime.ts calls adapter.whenIdle?.() and types.ts declares it; only the Apple Music adapter implements it.

SpotifyAdapter.whenIdle() resolves when its cancelled Connect start settles (after the settle pause), bounded 2 s from the cancel; past the bound the next prepare refuses with "still finishing the previous start request. Retry in a moment". Runtime tests drive a real SpotifyAdapter: a seek, or a pause then resume, during an in-flight start ends in one new start at 60000 ms and status playing; both fail on the old adapter. Adapter tests cover null, settle-then-replace at a new cue, and the bound. Local gate green except e2e (Chromium not installed locally; CI runs it). Mock players only: real Spotify audio not checked.
Deploy 2026-11-13: RF-158 live on Worker 78f9eb69 (main 579c5950). Deploy only; no Spotify playback checked.
